# Maqbool Essential
Use disciplined, slim product UI like Apple Files and Google Drive. Existing 224px sidebar, 70px header, bundled colorful geometric brand and Maqbool wordmark. Inter 13px body, 12px controls, 22px headings. Light #f7f8f7 canvas white surface #202923 text #e2e8e3 fine dividers. Dark #101113 canvas #191b1f surfaces #23252a inputs #32363d dividers #9cd7b9 action; never dark green. White space is intentional, not oversized. Compact rows, 8px corners, no nested card forests, no giant hero/status cards, no decorative illustrations. One main action and one quiet secondary per surface; less frequent actions in a More menu. Stable 860x760 dialogs: fixed header/tabs/footer, scrolling body. No technical implementation terms. Warnings only at the decision they affect. Do not add fake billing, nav, stats, activity sidebars, avatars or fabricated data policies. Purposeful line icons only, 140ms transitions and reduced-motion support.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed both the Light and Dark desktop screens for the **Task Detail Dialog (`HR-001 Prepare the welcome guide`)** over the Studio North Work stream view in strict alignment with Maqbool Essential design tokens and product permissions.

### Design Details & Craft Rationale:
- **Maqbool Shell & Foundations**:
  - Maintained the persistent 224px sidebar with original 4-color geometric logo mark, primary navigation items (`Home`, `Projects`, `My work`, `Inbox`), and `Settings` at bottom.
  - Kept 70px project header with Studio North identity, project planned indicator, navigation tabs (`Overview`, `Work` active, `Timeline`, `Updates`, `Files`, `Delivery`), and secondary/primary actions.
- **Strict Color Tokens & Separation**:
  - **Light Mode (`SCREEN_22`)**: `#f7f8f7` canvas, crisp white dialog surface, `#202923` primary text, `#69736d` secondary muted, `#176b50` primary forest green, with restrained hairline borders (`#e3e6e4`).
  - **Dark Mode (`SCREEN_21`)**: `#101113` canvas, `#191b1f` dialog surface, `#23252a` subtle action blocks, `#32363d` hairline borders, `#f0f1f3` text, `#a8adb5` muted, and `#9cd7b9` soft mint primary (with no dark green backgrounds).
- **Exact Modal Footprint & Scroll Hygiene**:
  - Fixed 860×760px dialog container centered over a softly dimmed backdrop.
  - Fixed header (64px) with code pill `HR-001`, task title, gray `To do` badge, and `· Unscheduled work` subtitle.
  - Fixed tab bar (42px) with `Details` active, plus count indicators for `Files and evidence (2)` and `Discussion (0)`.
  - Scrollable body with no content overflow or floating gaps.
- **Permission-Aware Next Action**:
  - Compact next-action banner at the top of the body: *"Start the project to begin this task"* explaining *"Your team can begin work once Welcome pack is active. You have permission to start the project."* paired with quiet secondary *"Edit task"* and primary action button *"Start project"*.
- **Structured 2-Column Metadata Grid**:
  - Dedicated row-aligned slots with uppercase micro-labels and clear values:
    - **Assignees**: Avatar stack with initials (`AR`, `SV`) and explicit label `Alex Rivera, Sam Vance`.
    - **Task lead**: Alex Rivera `(Owner)`.
    - **Parent project**: `Welcome pack` with planned status pill.
    - **Priority**: High semantic amber badge.
    - **Due date**: `2 Oct 2026` with calendar indicator.
    - **Work phase**: `Wave 1 · First essentials`.
- **Content & Governance**:
  - Plain, customer-facing paragraphs for `Description` and `What done looks like`.
  - Concise blockers section showing *"No open blockers"* with an *"Add blocker"* trigger.
  - Review policy summary explaining that independent reviewer sign-off is required once work is submitted.
  - Subdued, non-destructive secondary footer actions (`Move task`, `Cancel task`, and `Close`).
